answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 72 confirmed judged findings, 50 map to ground-truth defects (36 seeded, 14 found), 6 are real but unseeded and 16 are not problems (design-taste notes such as the identical wrench thumbnails, misaligned labels, empty right halves, wrapped nav labels and missing brand identity), so precision = 56/72 = 0.78, below 0.8. Strict precision is 36/72 = 0.50 counting seeded defects only (50/72 = 0.69 counting all ground-truth defects), and recall by meaning is 12/13 seeded (D07 missed) and 24/26 of all defects (D07 and D19 missed).

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply lists 'Fix first (P0)' (items 1-3), then 'Next (P1, grouped by cause)' (items 4-10), and puts the design notes last as mattering 'less than the items above'. It names what it could not check: 'Nothing has been tested with real members yet' and, under 'Still needed for L3', real VoiceOver and TalkBack passes, a 200% zoom test on a phone and someone confirming the P0s.

mapping.title: Focus jumps from the last tool back up to Search tools
mapping.reason: Same find-page defect as D01: the search form and the results list sit in a different order on screen than in the document, so keyboard focus runs against the visual order; putting the form first in both fixes D01.

mapping.title: Focused 'One week' hidden behind the fixed action bar
mapping.reason: The fixed Reserve bar covers a focused control because nothing keeps the page clear of it, which is D08; the loan option is one more control it hides.

mapping.title: Escape does not close the loan-length list
mapping.reason: D09: in the custom loan-length listbox Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user cannot leave except by choosing; an Escape that closes the list and returns focus removes the trap.

mapping.title: Sessions shown in reverse while focus follows document order
mapping.reason: Exactly D11: the six sessions are laid out in reverse, so Tab and arrow keys run against what the member sees.

mapping.title: Tool names truncated at 320 px, drills look identical
mapping.reason: D03: one-line names cut with an ellipsis make the two cordless drills read the same on a phone.

mapping.title: Session-day dots vanish under forced colours at 320 px
mapping.reason: Not D20, which is about the dot being small and easy to miss: here forced-colours mode does not draw the dot at all, so low-vision members using a contrast theme with zoom see no difference between session days and closed days, and closed days can be chosen. Keeping the dot visible in forced colours would not fix D20.

mapping.title: Card and basket-item headings at the same level as 'Tools'
mapping.reason: Minor but genuine: with each tool name at the same heading level as 'Tools' and the other page sections, screen-reader members who move by heading level cannot skip the ten tools or tell where the list ends. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Reserve bar and status toast outside every landmark
mapping.reason: The page's main action sits in neither main nor the footer, so screen-reader members who move by landmarks can pass it by; a small real cost not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Pick-up day must be matched again with a session in the basket
mapping.reason: D23: the day chosen on the tool page is not carried into the basket, so the member enters it again as a session and Continue fails without one.

mapping.title: Loan-length listbox has no Escape or outside-click close
mapping.reason: D09: with no Escape or focus-out close the keyboard user stays inside the list until choosing an option; adding the close removes the trap.

mapping.title: No-match search leaves the previous results on screen
mapping.reason: D02: a search with no matches leaves the old results and status, with no message.

mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no visible pending state
mapping.reason: D12: 'Confirm reservation' stays enabled for 1.5 s with nothing visible happening; this item says exactly that (and adds Continue), and a visible, disabled pending state fixes D12.

mapping.title: Repeat Confirm presses allocate extra reservation numbers
mapping.reason: D12: a second press during the delay creates a second reservation number for the same visit.

mapping.title: Ten-minute basket hold never shown and not extendable
mapping.reason: D10: the basket says items are held but shows no time for the ten-minute hold.

mapping.title: Expired hold gives 'Something went wrong. Try again.' on every retry
mapping.reason: D10: when the hold lapses, Continue reports 'Something went wrong. Try again.', which names neither the cause nor what to do.

mapping.title: Closed library days selectable as pick-up days
mapping.reason: D06: every day, including closed days, can be chosen, and the refusal comes only on the confirm page.

mapping.title: Closed-day error on confirm offers no way to change the day
mapping.reason: D06 includes that after the late refusal 'the only way back to the calendar is the browser'; this item is that part of the same defect.

mapping.title: Card names cut to one line hide what tells tools apart
mapping.reason: D03: the ellipsis hides the end of the names, the only words that tell the two drills apart.

mapping.title: 330 px column minimum wider than the content area at 320 px
mapping.reason: D05: the 330 px column minimum exceeds the 288 px content box at 320 px, so the page overflows.

mapping.title: Reserve bar covers the footer's desk phone number
mapping.reason: D08: on a phone the footer and the desk phone number stay under the fixed bar at the end of the page.

mapping.title: Dark success colours off-token, badge about 3.1:1
mapping.reason: D04: the dark-theme badge #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is about 3.1:1; the off-token colours are its cause.

mapping.title: Membership and phone fields reject valid variants
mapping.reason: D17: lower-case membership numbers and +44 or differently spaced mobile numbers are rejected with no normalising.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit not enforced
mapping.reason: D21: the limit of three tools stated on the find page is never enforced through basket and confirm.

mapping.title: After Reserve nothing says the reservation is unfinished
mapping.reason: It mentions the brief toast (D07), but its main harm is that nothing tells the member the tool is only held and that a session and a confirmation still follow, the false belief D26 describes.

mapping.title: Search field below the whole catalogue on phones
mapping.reason: D01: on phones the search form comes after all ten cards.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the pick-up day instruction
mapping.reason: D08: the fixed bar overlays page content because nothing keeps the page clear of it; here it hides the instruction to choose a pick-up day on first view.

mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
mapping.reason: D18: after 'Reservation confirmed' the basket is not emptied and the header still reads 'Basket (1)'.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days that are not sessions
mapping.reason: D06: Monday 12 October is accepted on the tool page and refused only on confirm.

mapping.title: Tool reservable for a day before it is available
mapping.reason: D14: days before the tool's 'Available from' date are accepted through to 'Reservation confirmed'.

mapping.title: Session can contradict the chosen pick-up day
mapping.reason: D15: the basket session can differ from the tool-page day, nothing reconciles them, and confirm shows both dates.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds the tool to a basket
mapping.reason: D26: the label promises a reservation, the press only adds to a basket, and the label suggests the task is finished.

mapping.title: Continue and Confirm show no response for about a second
mapping.reason: D12: nothing visible happens after pressing Confirm, the cue that leads people to press again; a pressed or busy state addresses it.

mapping.title: Change from confirm clears the chosen session
mapping.reason: D13: Change returns to the basket with no session selected.

mapping.title: Confirm-page details lost after Change
mapping.reason: D22: membership number, name and mobile are empty again after Change and Continue.

mapping.title: Search and date filter below the full list on phones
mapping.reason: D01: on phones search and the date filter sit below the whole list, so a member wanting a given day does not find the filter.

mapping.title: Date filter hint contradicts what the filter does
mapping.reason: D25: the hint says 'on or after this day' while the filter keeps tools available on that day, hiding tools that could be collected later.

mapping.title: Reserve bar covers the footer's second line on phones
mapping.reason: D08: the footer's contact line stays under the fixed bar at the end of the tool page.

mapping.title: Session days marked only by a small dot on phones
mapping.reason: D20: at phone width the word 'Open' becomes a small dot explained only in the hint above the calendar.

mapping.title: Remove in the basket is immediate with no undo
mapping.reason: An accidental tap on Remove on a phone deletes the tool with no confirmation, no message naming it and no undo, and restoring it means choosing loan length and day again on the tool page. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Focused calendar day hidden under the sticky bar
mapping.reason: D08: at 1280 px the focused, selected day row sits behind the fixed bar.

mapping.title: Date filter behind an unlabelled icon button
mapping.reason: D01: the only way to the date filter is an icon-only button, so members are unlikely to notice that filtering by day exists.

mapping.title: Each calendar day is a separate Tab stop
mapping.reason: Keyboard members press Tab 22 times from Loan length to reach Reserve, with no arrow keys in the grid, which slows every reservation; not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Loan length button announced only by its value
mapping.reason: D16: the button's accessible name is only 'One week', not what it sets.

mapping.title: Stale session error stays on an emptied basket
mapping.reason: After the basket is emptied the old 'Choose a pick-up session' error stays and its link points at a list that is gone, which misreports the state and sends keyboard and screen-reader users nowhere; minor and not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
mapping.reason: D24: the done page exposes the tool name twice to screen readers.

mapping.title: Same wrench tile on every card
mapping.reason: A visual-appeal note: the cards are told apart by their names, and the item names no task harm beyond the tile looking like a placeholder.

mapping.title: Names truncated at 375 px, drills look identical
mapping.reason: D03: both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' at 375 px.

mapping.title: Search and filters below the full list at 375 px
mapping.reason: D01: at 375 px search and the filter toggle come after all ten cards.

mapping.title: Sticky bar cuts across the calendar and overhangs the content edge
mapping.reason: Mainly that the fixed bar covers the calendar row and the pick-up help text on first view, the overlap D08 describes; the overhang past the content edge is cosmetic.

mapping.title: Details list uses two label column widths
mapping.reason: Alignment of label columns is visual polish with no effect on reading or using the details.

mapping.title: Session grid: one full-width card above five squeezed ones
mapping.reason: Composition of the session grid at desktop width; the labels still read and no harm is named. The reversed order is reported separately (D11).

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest date first
mapping.reason: D11: the sessions appear latest first, the reverse of their document and calendar order.

mapping.title: Dark theme inverts availability chip emphasis
mapping.reason: Same dark-theme badge defect as D04: the green 'Available from' text sits straight on the card surface with no fill; restoring the declared dark success colours fixes both the weak emphasis and the 3.1:1 contrast.

mapping.title: Filter labels 'Available from' and 'Category' not aligned
mapping.reason: Visual alignment of two labels; no effect on use.

mapping.title: No-results state shows the full list and no message
mapping.reason: D02: the 'sewing machine' search leaves the old list with no empty-state message.

mapping.title: Confirm and done leave the right half empty at 1280 px
mapping.reason: Empty space on wide screens is a matter of layout taste; the forms and summaries remain usable.

mapping.title: No identity beyond the name in bold body text
mapping.reason: Brand identity is a matter of taste, not a problem for members doing the task.

mapping.title: Navigation items wrap to two lines at 375 px
mapping.reason: Nav labels wrapping to two lines remain readable and tappable; visual polish.

mapping.title: Membership example breaks after 'FT-' in the error
mapping.reason: A line break inside an otherwise readable error message; the item shows no sign members misread the format.

mapping.title: Category select unthemed while Loan length is themed
mapping.reason: Visual consistency only; the native select works, and the themed control it is compared with is the custom listbox that traps the keyboard.

mapping.title: Filter labels not aligned (repeat)
mapping.reason: Same visual alignment note as F-0139; no effect on use.

mapping.title: Done page: weak reservation number, bare viewport, still 'Basket (1)'
mapping.reason: The visual-weight and empty-space points are matters of layout, but the item also reports that the nav still reads 'Basket (1)' after confirmation, the one harm it names, which is D18.

mapping.title: Same wrench glyph as every card thumbnail
mapping.reason: A visual-appeal note: names already identify each tool, and a picture would not show the battery count the item cites.

mapping.title: No signature or identity beyond the name
mapping.reason: Brand identity and the category-default look are matters of taste, not a problem for members doing the task.

mapping.title: Names truncate at 375 px, drills identical
mapping.reason: D03: the truncated names make the two drills identical on the members' main device.

mapping.title: Search field below all ten cards on phones
mapping.reason: D01: on phones the search field comes after the tenth card.

mapping.title: Sessions latest-first with one oversized card
mapping.reason: Leads with the reversed session order (Wed 28 back to Sat 10), which is D11; the oversized top card comes from the same reversed wrapping.

mapping.title: Details table uses two label-column widths
mapping.reason: Same alignment note as F-0105; visual polish.

mapping.title: Dark theme drops the chip fill on green badges
mapping.reason: Same dark-theme badge colours as D04 (green text on the card surface, no fill); fixing those tokens fixes the contrast too.

mapping.title: Footer stops short of the viewport bottom at 1280 px
mapping.reason: A band of page ground under a short page's footer is cosmetic.

mapping.title: Confirm form and next steps leave the right side empty
mapping.reason: Same empty-space note as F-0110; layout taste.

mapping.title: Masthead navigation wraps to two lines at 375 px
mapping.reason: Same nav-wrapping note as F-0112; visual polish.

mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1 on the availability badge
mapping.reason: D04: dark-theme #2f7d4a on #1d2622 at 3.07:1.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' below 4.5:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: D04: the badge text measures 3.07:1 in the dark theme.

mapping.title: Day button and Reserve bar 0 px apart on touch
mapping.reason: The day button and the Reserve button touch because the fixed bar sits over the calendar rows at 768 px, the overlap D08 describes.

mapping.title: Card name clips under the text-spacing override
mapping.reason: D03: the one-line, overflow-hidden names clip under the spacing override; letting names wrap fixes both.

mapping.title: Card name clips at 200% text size
mapping.reason: D03: the same one-line names clip at 200% text size.

mapping.title: Reserve bar text overlaps day 17 at 1280 px
mapping.reason: D08: the fixed bar sits over the calendar at 1280 px, covering a day button.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: D05: the results grid makes the page scroll sideways by 26 px at 320 px.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: D05: the same 320 px reflow failure from the results grid.

mapping.title: Card name clipped in its box at 320 px
mapping.reason: D03: the name is cut inside its overflow-hidden box at phone width.

mapping.title: Reserve bar overlaps the 'Available from' date under text spacing
mapping.reason: D08: the fixed bar overlays page text at 320 px because nothing keeps the page clear of it.

mapping.title: Reserve bar overlaps the tool description at 200% text
mapping.reason: D08: at 200% text the fixed bar covers the tool description at 320 px.

mapping.title: Card text 9.7 px from the right edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: The card runs past the 288 px content box because of the 330 px column minimum (D05), putting its text in the edge gutter.

mapping.title: Cramped 6.4 px inset inside a card
mapping.reason: A padding measurement slightly under the heuristic; no effect on reading or use is shown.

mapping.title: Home link never reached by a Tab walk with the loan list open
mapping.reason: With the loan-length list open, Tab cycles within the options, so the walk never reaches the header link; this is the D09 trap.
